title: The Echoes of Multilinguality: Tracing Cultural Value Shifts during LM Fine-tuning
reasoning: The study specifically evaluates cultural values using the World Values Survey (WVS), which includes dedicated categories for 'Religious Values' and 'Ethical Values and Norms'. Furthermore, the researchers use the Parallel Bible Corpus (Bible) and the Tanzil dataset (Quran) as fine-tuning sources to specifically analyze how religious data influences the model's cultural and ethical alignment.
